lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 13 distinct vertical white stripes are visible. Spacing is greatest across the mid-torso and compresses significantly as stripes approach the anterior shoulder and neck regions.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 3rd stripe from the posterior, merging near the dorsal ridge. A second partial split is observed on the 5th stripe from the posterior at the mid-flank level.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st posterior stripe is a short segment terminating 1/3 down the flank. The 12th and 13th anterior stripes are abbreviated, terminating before the ventral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 3 distinct white spots is located on the lower posterior haunch, forming a triangular configuration below the primary stripe field.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower haunch demonstrate horizontal alignment relative to the ventral plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white horizontal band on the lower neck/throat area and white markings on the distal limbs just above the hooves.
